chunks: And from him, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"The Imam must pray the Dhuhr prayer on the Day of Tarwiyah at Masjid al-Khayf, and pray the Dhuhr prayer on the Day of Nafar in Masjid al-Haram."

key_terms.التَّرْوِيَةِ: The Day of Tarwiyah, the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah when pilgrims proceed to Mina.
key_terms.النَّفْرِ: The Day of Nafar, referring to the 11th or 12th of Dhu al-Hijjah when pilgrims depart from Mina.
key_terms.مَسْجِدُ الْخَيْفِ: Masjid al-Khayf, the mosque located in Mina.

ai.seo_question: Where does the Imam pray Dhuhr on the Day of Tarwiyah and the Day of Nafar during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the jurisprudential distinction between the Imam’s congregational prayers during the Hajr rituals, highlighting the transition from Mina to Mecca. It underscores the Imam’s role in guiding the community through the specific liturgical movements of the pilgrimage, reflecting the structured nature of Hajj rites as codified by the Imams. The specification of locations reinforces the sanctity of both Mina and the Haram, linking physical movement with spiritual progression.
